description: Our goal is simple: find a meaningful NASA challenge, build a strong solution, and make the most of the hackathon.
summary:
AgriShift is a data-driven agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make informed crop-rotation decisions by analysing climate conditions, water availability, soil health, vegetation and economic factors.

Built using Python, Streamlit, Pandas and Plotly, the application transforms agricultural datasets into interactive visualizations and practical insights. It features seven sections: Dashboard, Farmer Profile, Rotation Analysis, Climate Explorer, Vegetation, Soil Health, and Data & Methodology.

Its central feature, Rotation Analysis, compares different crop rotations across four dimensions: water suitability, environmental risk, soil suitability and income per acre. The scoring methodology uses continuous values between 0 and 100, allowing more nuanced comparisons instead of simplistic binary ratings.

The platform also incorporates responsive desktop and mobile navigation, interactive charts, project documentation and custom branding.

AgriShift aims to demonstrate how data science can address real-world agricultural challenges, particularly the impact of changing climate conditions on farming decisions. By combining environmental and economic indicators, it seeks to make complex agricultural information more accessible and useful for farmers.

Ultimately, the project explores how technology and data-driven analysis can contribute to more sustainable agricultural practices and informed decision-making in Pakistan.
details:
AgriShift is a data-driven agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make informed crop-rotation decisions using climate, environmental and economic data. It analyses factors such as rainfall, water availability, soil suitability, vegetation and crop economics to compare different crop rotations and identify potentially suitable options.

The platform works by processing agricultural and climate datasets, applying analytical scoring methods and presenting the results through interactive dashboards and visualizations. Its Rotation Analysis feature evaluates crop rotations across four dimensions: water suitability, environmental risk, soil suitability and income per acre. Each dimension receives a continuous score between 0 and 100, allowing more nuanced comparisons.

AgriShift benefits farmers by making complex agricultural information easier to interpret and helping them consider environmental and economic trade-offs before selecting crops. Its intended impact is to encourage more sustainable farming practices, improve resource awareness and demonstrate how data science can support agricultural decision-making in Pakistan.

The project was developed using Python, Streamlit, Pandas and Plotly, with CSV datasets for storing and processing information. No specialised hardware was required.

Its creativity lies in combining multiple agricultural indicators into one interactive decision-support system rather than examining climate, soil and economics independently. During development, we considered usability, data reliability, scoring fairness, environmental sustainability, economic feasibility and accessibility across desktop and mobile devices.
